rationale: In the early campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 2.06, median uncertainty is 1.83, 80 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 5.03. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
expected_outcome: The batch will have a mean affinity of at least 6.6 and add at least 5 new scaffolds.
